events.title: Final DEMO.
events.summary: With the release of Chapter One just around the corner, we’ve decided to give you an expanded demo.It includes the prologue and part of Chapter One, where you’ll meet three of the five companions and may find yourself dying more times than you’d care to.We’ve also added new fonts to make the game easier to read. You can switch between them in the game’s settings.

events.title: DEMO updated ver. 1.2
events.summary: QOL Updates for the DemoThanks to the feedback from friends, communities, and Reddit users.Added a customizable textbox background to improve readability. One of the main issues was that text could be difficult to read against the highly detailed black-and-white backgrounds, especially in English. Now you can adjust the textbox transparency to your preference. events.title: The Demo for "Sirin's Feather" Is Now Available!
